$comment: PRE-PUBLICATION AMENDMENT (2026-08-23): the probe kind `mcp-discover` was added in place while nothing external consumes this artifact; immutability binds from first publication (standard README note). Grounds: the E09 wire suite established that the pinned MCP revision has no `initialize` method, so `mcp-initialize` cannot prove liveness there — a probe kind for the stateless era was the missing vocabulary, not a defect in the checker. PRE-PUBLICATION AMENDMENT (2026-08-26): every ld.openhelvetia.org identifier was reminted to ld.openhelvetia.swiss in place, while nothing external consumes this artifact; immutability binds from first publication (standard README note, VERSIONING.md). Grounds: the sealed E03 Revisions-Nachtrag of 24.08.2026 makes openhelvetia.swiss the SINGLE public entry and ld.openhelvetia.swiss the home of the permanent identifiers — the remint is legal precisely because every affected artifact is still draft, and it must complete BEFORE publication.
title: OpenHelvetia directory envelope
description: Envelope for the published directory index (v0.2, L0.8 cold-start hardening). The directory is DERIVED data: on any divergence from a manifest, the manifest governs (authority rule). 0.x draft without stability promise until ratification by the standards commission.

authority.description: Machine-readable divergence rule: the manifest is the authoritative source; the directory index is derived from it.

manifest.description: Absolute URL of the byte-identical machine manifest (sibling principle).

probe.description: Liveness-probe hint (L0.8): the minimal harmless call that proves the interface is alive, so a cold-start agent never has to guess a safe request.

expect.description: ok = 2xx required · boolean = SPARQL ASK result document · response = any HTTP answer proves liveness (bot walls included).

target.description: Optional probe URL when it differs from the endpoint.
